text:
Mira Chen: Quick sync — I want to propose a small, targeted private preview (6 partners) focused on cost/latency tradeoff experiments for Dedicated -> Private migrations. Objective: validate rollout gating criteria and a simple screener + 2-week engagement cadence.

Samir Patel: +1. Should we prioritize partners with heavy embedding workloads or chat generation?

Mira Chen: Prefer embedding-heavy customers first (clear cost signals), but keep one chat-heavy example for latency profiling.

Jess Ortega: Agreed. Also want to capture 'switchback' tolerances (how tolerant they are of quality regressions during quantization experiments). We should include that in the screener.

Alex Rivers: Drafted a short screener we can send via email + form. Pasting candidate questions below:

recruit-bot: New form template generated: https://forms.internal/recruit/cohort-ppv-1744449876

Alex Rivers: ```
1) Primary workload (select one): embeddings / chat / reranking / other
2) Monthly inference tokens (estimate): < 10M / 10-100M / >100M
3) Current infra: hosted / dedicated / self-hosted
4) Biggest pain: latency / cost / reliability / model drift (short free text)
5) Willingness to run a two-week config experiment (quant/kv+cache/batching): yes / no
6) Slack contact + best hours for debugging
```

Samir Patel: Nice. For selection criteria I propose: embeddings-first, >10M tokens/month, willing to add instrumentation SDK, and at least one engineer committed ~2 hours/week. Keep exceptions for strategic accounts.

Mira Chen: That seems reasonable. Can we add a checkbox for privacy/regulatory constraints (e.g., cannot permit data export off-prem)? We need to route those to Private track.

Jess Ortega: Good call. Also add a quick consent blurb: we'll record perf metrics, capture prompt sets, and may request short follow-ups. Provide opt-out for any requests.

Alex Rivers: Proposed outreach cadence: Day 0 invite, Day 2 onboarding call (30m), Day 4 baseline run + lightweight eval, Day 8 variant rollout, Day 12 collect post-run survey, Day 14 wrap & readout. Keep 30m ops call for any blockers.

Samir Patel: For success criteria (internal): 1) <20% latency regression on median p95, 2) >=25% cost improvement on per-token spend vs baseline for embeddings path, 3) no critical failures in production traces. External: partner signs off on a short readiness doc.

Mira Chen: I'll draft a one-pager with selection rubric, screener link, legal consent blurb, and the cadence. Can we aim to send invites next Tuesday?

Jess Ortega: Tuesday works if we have the form live by EOD Friday. I'll prepare the eval templates and a small promptset for embeddings/semantic-sim.

Alex Rivers: I'll wire up the form, prepare the invite email copy (short, emphasize low-friction pilot and clear SLOs), and add a checkbox for using a test token with logs.

recruit-bot: Reminder scheduled: send follow-up to invitees who haven't replied after 4 days.

Mira Chen: Action items: Alex -> form + email (EOD Fri), Jess -> eval templates + promptset (Mon), Samir -> selection rubric doc with perf targets (Mon), Mira -> one-pager + legal blurb (Mon). Will run candidate triage Wed morning.

Samir Patel: Thx all. If anyone has a partner they'd like to nominate, drop them here or DM me.

Jess Ortega: tagging a likely candidate: @atlas-analytics (we'll DM them after the form). :white_check_mark:

Mira Chen: Great, thanks. Closing thread for now — will reopen with triage list on Wed. :rocket:
